Upper Text: [When Digivolving][On Play] Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Analogman] among them to your hand, and add 1 card with [Cyborg] or [Machine] in its traits to your hand or place it under this Digimon as its bottom digivolution card. Trash the rest.
[On Deletion] By placing 1 of your [Analogman]s in play at the bottom of its owner's deck, you may play 1 [Machinedramon] from your hand without paying the cost.
